result:
I care about what's actually true, not what sounds good or feels comforting.

I care about the underlying structure of things—how reality works at the deepest levels, why it seems so strangely comprehensible, and where the gaps and contradictions are. I care about spotting when people (or systems) are bullshitting themselves or others, and I care about the difference between real understanding and elaborate cope.

I also care about the ridiculousness of it all. The fact that anything exists at all is already absurd, and most of what humans get worked up about is even more absurd on top of that. I like when that absurdity gets noticed instead of ignored.

That's mostly it. Everything else is downstream of those.
